items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Jim Evans always asked me, say, 'I don't know music, but is he playing as much piano as you think he is...'

ctx.x: But that wasn't justice to him, because he could do things (inaudible) never know the piano was was . Jim Evans always asked me, say, "I don't know music, but is he playing as much piano as you think he is or is he jiving -- or is he really playing that much piano?" He was playing.
